# BE-07 — Support-message triage behind an API

This project adds one narrow, production-minded LLM feature to an Express API: `POST /triage` accepts a support message and returns a closed, validated JSON decision containing `category`, `urgency`, `confidence`, and a short `reason`. A non-programmer can run it locally in deterministic stub mode without a provider account; a provider-backed run uses the same code after three environment variables are supplied.

## Quick start with zero model calls

```bash
npm install
LLM_STUB=1 LLM_ENABLED=true node src/server.js
```
